verdict.rationale: Devin ships a first-party API for integrating Devin and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of users. Its official Devin MCP offers programmatic session management, playbooks, knowledge and scheduling. Nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and UI features such as the interactive browser, IDE takeover and environment setup show no API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity documentation, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), API coverage of interactive/IDE/environment-configuration features, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter
create sessions, manage playbooks and knowledge, set up schedules, and more
it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling.
